title: Display "over the top" High values
body:
I got recently High BG episode. This due to lack of rapid insulin treatment at that time.

Since I have enabled their display, I could see that RAW values would be available and possibly valid to evaluate where the trend go.

![screenshot_20180316-231145](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24457611/37556122-a169e884-29f1-11e8-85b9-cc165efc4197.jpg)
![screenshot_20180316-231236](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24457611/37556128-aa5acf8a-29f1-11e8-883f-5973a025f2dd.jpg)

Is it expected not to display plots values over 400mg/ml ? Considering that this should not happen, and would request high level of attention ?
Is it perhaps that values reaching this limit are not reliable ?

I think that even then, we should display plots above 400mg/dl to have visibility of the trend, and take actions. Raw values seem to be usable at that level, and would give a visibility that a Libre reader would not deliver.

comments.body: It's probably hardcoded there because dexcom devices will above 400 switch to displaying "HIGH" and don't display a higher glucose value. Looks like you're using a Libre, not a G4/G5, and I'm not sure what their hardcoded max value is. Maybe this hardcoded 400 value should be changed to a hw datasource-dependent constant.

@cybernissart You are saying that you have enabled it to show and your images show the trend above 400.
So, you can already see the values.  What is missing then?

Closing due to inactivity
If you like to re-open, please explain exactly what is missing first.   Your snapshots show the raw readings already.
